evidence.title: Hierarchical Exponential-Gaussian Mixtures for Watch-Time Distribution Prediction

summary: Researchers have introduced a hierarchical exponential‑Gaussian mixture framework that more accurately forecasts how long viewers will watch videos. Tests on large‑scale streaming datasets show the model outperforms existing approaches in both precision and robustness.
title: New Hierarchical Exponential‑Gaussian Mixture Model Boosts Watch‑Time Distribution Prediction
